system.history:
A taxi, bus, delivery, rideshare, or service driver who knows local streets and traffic patterns.

Scene use: Transport contact, crash witness, evacuation driver, pursuit participant, or source of neighborhood information.
system.personality: Alert, adaptable, and accustomed to difficult passengers and sudden route changes. Knows when the streets feel wrong.
system.distinguishingFeatures: Vehicle keys, route device, work identification, radio, and weather-appropriate driving clothes.

system.description: A defensive close strike with a flashlight or roadside tool.
